entries.command: map, find, context, endpoint, audit effects, commit analyze, commit auto
entries.expected: Invalid values and conflicting modes fail during parsing before a map build or mutation.
entries.observed: The live Kong model accepted invalid enums, negative bounds, conflicting JSON modes, unknown forced modes, and an obsolete hidden flag.
entries.repro: repomap --json --json-structured .; repomap find --limit=-1 x; repomap commit analyze --confidence=2
entries.proposed_fix: Add Kong enums and command Validate methods with documented zero semantics.

entries.expected: Only successful command output atomically replaces a regular target; failures preserve the prior file and permissions.
entries.observed: os.Create truncated the target before command execution and could leave partial output.
entries.proposed_fix: Stage in the target directory, chmod, run, sync, close, and rename after success; reject unsafe targets.

entries.expected: Output writer and flush errors reach the process boundary.
entries.observed: Several formatters ignored fmt, tabwriter, buffered, and JSON-RPC write failures.
entries.repro: Invoke formatters with a writer that always returns an error.
entries.proposed_fix: Check each stdout write and propagate the first write or flush failure; keep stderr progress best-effort.

entries.expected: A successful human search explicitly distinguishes zero matches from lost output.
entries.observed: Zero matches produced empty stdout while JSON correctly represented an empty collection.
entries.proposed_fix: Print a deterministic text no-result message while preserving JSON as [].

entries.expected: Kong command and flag tags are recognized, including name overrides and hidden compatibility surfaces.
entries.observed: The scanner only recognized Cobra and standard flag registration, so Repomap's Kong CLI reported zero commands and flags.
entries.proposed_fix: Parse Kong cmd, name, help, arg, and hidden struct tags during surface scanning.

entries.command: audit surface, audit effects, audit brief
entries.expected: Every cap has structured field, shown, total, and reason metadata, including per-file effects.
entries.observed: Aggregate caps were silent and effect-file caps lacked omission metadata.
entries.repro: Run audit effects on a file containing more than twelve recognized effects.
entries.proposed_fix: Add schema-v3 truncation entries and per-file omitted_reason fields.

entries.expected: Embedded per-file surface hits and effects are representative and compact, with all omissions disclosed.
entries.observed: Brief packets retained the detailed command caps of twelve hits/effects per file.
entries.repro: Compare audit brief and detailed effects packets for a dense file.
entries.proposed_fix: Cap embedded per-file hits and effects at four and record original totals.

entries.expected: The QA matrix, live parser model, help, README, and configuration reference evolve together.
entries.observed: No actual-model coverage guard existed and many subcommand flags were absent from the main documentation.
entries.repro: Inventory parser.Model leaves and inherited flags and compare them to the documentation.
entries.proposed_fix: Add a 29-leaf registration matrix and parser-to-help/docs parity tests.

entries.expected: Only surfaces requested by the approved scope are added.
entries.observed: A generic CLI checklist suggested version and completion commands, but the approved plan explicitly excludes them.
entries.repro: Compare the generic checklist to the locked implementation scope.
entries.proposed_fix: None; retain the existing command surface.

entries.expected: Machine mode emits one valid JSON document through the injected command writer; human dry-run output is artifact-aware.
entries.observed: The library printed dry-run prose directly to os.Stdout before the CLI JSON result, contaminating JSON and bypassing --artifact.
entries.proposed_fix: Inject the human output writer into ExecuteOptions and suppress prose when JSON is selected.

entries.expected: Kind filtering runs against every detected effect before the per-file effect cap and file limit are applied.
entries.observed: Filtering the already capped packet could omit a requested kind that occurred after the first twelve effects and could retain stale truncation metadata.
entries.repro: Place thirteen serialization effects before one filesystem write, then run repomap audit effects --kind filesystem-write --limit=0 --json.
entries.proposed_fix: Retain the uncapped effect set for filtering, rebuild filtered kinds and lanes, then apply per-file and file caps with fresh truncation metadata.

entries.expected: Kong-derived command and flag names match the CLI, including initialisms and hidden-only compatibility flags.
entries.observed: The initial Kong scanner rendered JSON and LSP as j-s-o-n and l-s-p and skipped fields carrying only a hidden tag.
entries.repro: Scan Kong fields named JSON, JSONLegacy, LSP, and a hidden-only CallsUseBinary field.
entries.proposed_fix: Use initialism-aware kebab casing and treat hidden, name, or short tags as sufficient flag evidence.
